Before you visit

A few things
to know.

How do I book an appointment?

Use the booking guide to explore your options, then continue to the spa’s official booking system. You can also call 317-979-1234. This preview does not reserve appointments.

Where can I see prices and session lengths?

Individual service pages include published menu prices and durations where available. They come from the supplied November 6, 2026 website snapshot. Confirm current prices and availability when booking.

Which service is right for me?

Start with the menu and talk with the spa about your preferences and suitability. For medical concerns, ask your qualified healthcare professional. No treatment outcome is guaranteed.

Are memberships available?

The source website lists massage and facial memberships. See memberships and contact the team to confirm current inclusions and terms.
